results.content: Email was always a conversation. We just forgot what one looks like. Talanoa is a modern email client that turns your inbox into something simpler, calmer, and more natural. Instead of navigating endless threads, repeated quotes, signatures, and subject lines, Talanoa makes email feel like a conversation. Messages become clean chat bubbles, with your replies on one side and theirs on the other. ONE PERSON. ONE CONVERSATION. See everything you’ve exchanged with someone in one continuous conversation, even across different subjects. No more searching through dozens of threads just to remember what you talked about. AN INBOX BUILT AROUND PEOPLE Talanoa separates the conversations that matter from newsletters, automated notifications, and noise, so your attention stays on real people. EMAILS [...] and noise, so your attention stays on real people. EMAILS BECOME ACTIONS Some emails need more than a reply. Turn any email into a task, add a due date, track its progress, and keep the original conversation attached. ALL YOUR ACCOUNTS. ONE PLACE. Connect Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo, and other IMAP accounts and manage them from one unified inbox. PRIVATE BY DESIGN Your mailbox stays on your device. Talanoa doesn’t store your emails on its servers, doesn’t track your email content, and doesn’t use your messages for advertising. Email doesn’t need another inbox. It needs to feel like a conversation again. FEATURES Chat Interface: Turns messy email threads into clean, natural chat bubbles. Unified History: Groups everything you've ever discussed with a person into one continuous flow.
